source.label: Bally Monte Carlo factory instruction cards

strategy.overview: Monte Carlo and its single-player sibling Odds & Evens reward complete number sets. Shoot the left orbit to cross the 1-10 rollovers. Completing all odd or all even numbers adds 5,000 to end-of-ball Bonus; completing both sets is far better than leaving each one short. If the upper-right gate opens, take its 4,000-point chute.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Monte Carlo or Odds & Evens, shoot the left orbit to collect the 1-10 rollovers. Finish all five odd or all five even numbers for a 5,000 Bonus add-on. If the upper-right gate opens, shoot through it for 4,000; otherwise keep going up top.
strategy.summary: Prioritize a complete odd or even set instead of spreading progress across both. The center saucer raises the center post and spots the lit odd number; the upper-left saucer spots the lit even number. Left mushroom bumpers open the two right-side gates.

quickInfo.name: Odd or even set
quickInfo.summary: Five completed numbers add 5,000 to Bonus in addition to 1,000 per lit number.

quickInfo.name: Center saucer
quickInfo.summary: Raises the center post and spots the lit odd number.

quickInfo.name: Upper-left saucer
quickInfo.summary: Spots the lit even number and can award Extra Ball when enabled.

quickInfo.name: Right-side gates
quickInfo.summary: The upper chute scores 4,000 and the lower chute 2,000 after their matching left mushroom bumpers open them.

steps.text: Shoot the left orbit to return the ball to the numbered top rollovers.
Nudge toward the missing numbers in whichever odd or even set is closest to completion.
Use the center saucer for the lit odd number and a raised center post, or the upper-left saucer for the lit even number.
When the upper-right gate is open, shoot its chute for 4,000; otherwise keep using the left orbit.
With the center post raised, let the ball settle against it and use micro-flips to regain control.

buildsToward.title: Completed odd and even number sets

steps.text: Choose the set with the stronger current progress.
Use top rollovers and spotting saucers to finish it.
Repeat for the other set while taking the open upper gate.

machineSetup: Confirm whether the copy is Monte Carlo or Odds & Evens, three- or five-ball play, and whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled, converted, or absent under the installed score card.
Test every numbered rollover and lamp, both spotting saucers, center-post raise and lower switches, both left mushroom bumpers, both right gates and chute switches, and all bumper-area exits.
